title: Out-of-family finite physical operator programming with phase-free contextual composition

parent.parent_status: focused and G29 PASS, full regression pending

central_question: Can a zero-gradient learner write exact, unknown discrete physical operator tables from charged unary actions, then reuse the tables in previously unseen noncommuting compositions after a grammar switch without any externally supplied phase selector?
falsifiable_hypothesis: Given 28 function-identifying one-step actions and 32 ordered-composition examples, directly constructed table weights plus evidence-suffix grammar inference can predict unseen operations and state combinations for deterministic non-affine 7-state dynamics, while exact-utterance memory and the old affine family fail.

source.independence: New deterministic source generator, not WSP53/WSP55 source functions; no model may import source.py or access evaluator-only codebook, operation tables, hidden roles or heldout labels.
source.state: 8 named-by-position observable state registers in Z7; no oracle semantic labels.
source.operations: four distinct independently sampled derangement permutations over Z7, each rejected if representable as any modular-affine map ax+b mod 7; discriminate operator composition order.
source.acoustic: 12 distinct deterministic 4-bit codewords, 8 entity identities and 4 operator identities; learner may infer 4-bit segments using declared fixed-length prior, receives only raw binary strings.
source.actions: 28 charged unary probes (4 operations x 7 input states), 20 charged phase-A ordered-composition observations, 12 charged phase-B ordered-composition observations. Every probe costs one action. No extra heldout adaptation.
source.grammar: Phase A has a source-hidden unary entity/operation order and independent 3-segment pair order. Phase B switches pair order. Learner sees only chronological physical transitions, raw bits, and costs; no phase label or 48/12 boundary passed to prediction.
source.heldout: 96 independent excluded composition/context challenges for each grammar per world, generated before scoring; exactly 6 worlds × 192 = 1152 prospective heldout cases. Query-specific entity/first/second/x tuple disjoint from charged pair training for that phase.
source.isolation: No DEV/PRIMARY exposure and no external physics source/unseen task-family claim.

candidate.algorithm: Observe unary physical transitions to ground entity codewords and write one 7-cell truth table for each of 4 operator codes. Match ordered composition against A history and continuously infer the current order from the longest evidence-consistent recent suffix; zero gradients; abstain when no unique prediction.
candidate.priors: 8 entity registers, 4 latent unary operators, 7-state integer domain, fixed 4-bit codeword length and physical observation format. Unary intervention availability is an information and action advantage relative to WSP55; all controls receive it equally.

comparators: Exact observation lookup using same 60 public actions; no label/key leakage
Best-fit modular-affine projection onto the candidate's independently acquired codeword and grammar maps (privileged structural ablation, not independent scientific control)
A fully trained conventional neural baseline and independent exhaustive symbolic search with matched compute/information are required before any scientific superiority claim.
metrics: aggregate 1152 heldout outcomes including all six fixtures
A snapshot before B and post-B cold restore exact parity
affine family representability negative and lookup comparator
wall/CPU time per world and model+raw-evidence persistent bytes
per-world raw action/heldout SHA256 custody and deterministic seed/encoding identity
exploratory_success: Prospective SELFTEST_SIGNAL if >=768/1152 correct heldout, zero wrong-confident, at least 24 correctly discriminated order swaps across aggregate, all six fixtures and cold restore valid, zero gradient updates. Otherwise preserve SELFTEST_NEGATIVE_OR_INCONCLUSIVE, never treat threshold as scientific acceptance.
guardrails: No heldout gradients, direct corrections, search-guided tuning or post-result threshold changes
Unknown operations are not supplied as oracle functions; learner never imports source
Do not use any predictor phase switch or evaluator-supplied regime selector
Do not call a source-family-specific exact table learned from 28 unary probes general reasoning or language understanding
No first-use of WSP53/WSP54/WSP55 DEV or PRIMARY; no paid APIs, scheduled tasks, new autonomous controllers or unsanctioned runner usage

If source generation, model, or test code fails pre-observation implementation sanity, repair only mechanics without changing frozen semantics; any behavioral redesign becomes a new separately frozen experiment
classification: Engineering SELFTEST only. No scientific novelty/superiority, fully general cognition, autonomous learning, external transfer or deployment claims.
